visual_action: A grey Toyota Prius with numerous bumper stickers is stopped at an intersection. Inside, two people with blue hair appear hot and uncomfortable. A sleek red sports car pulls up beside them. A close-up shows a finger pressing a button to disable the car's auto start-stop feature. The driver of the sports car, a blonde woman, sips a soda. The sports car then revs its engine and speeds away, leaving the Prius behind.
